dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: My name is Erebos. In the Inazuman tongue, that would be Eboshi.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: You have proven here that your valor is beyond compare — that you are a worthy savior of Sangonomiya's people. Thus, you have earned the right to ask and to be answered.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: Still, I ask that you follow the rules and not take the truth beyond this ocean abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: What else do you wish to know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Bathysmal Vishaps...

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: They are primordial elemental beings, unbent and unbowed by the power that came from the heavens owing to their living deep underwater.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: They are actually very intelligent, and they are adept at evolving. They would even evolve into different elemental forms throughout the history of their war against us.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: I would not be surprised at all if they have learned language or perhaps even evolved into lizard-people of a sort.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: The Holy Soil phenomenon is, in fact, the expansion of their habitat. That means that the primordial elemental power of the three realms is growing stronger.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: Only by using Watatsumi Omikami's life force to awaken its second servant could we convert this raw, raging elemental power.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Watatsumi Omikami...

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: Watatsumi Omikami, due to ill-fortune, fell into this place, beyond the jurisdiction of the heavenly order.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: But this was undoubtedly to the good fortune of us, the people of Byakuyakoku. It has done a great many things for us.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, by making contact with us, it also grasped a truth that came before its own existence. Thus, it was forced to seek a valiant death.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: Thus, the people would no longer suspect that there might be secrets that lay hidden in the shadows. This was the only way the people of Byakuyakoku would be allowed to live under the rule of The Seven.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what were things like before the sun and moon?

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: Before Byakuyakoku fell into the deep sea, the whole world had a single unified culture.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: Later, a great war broke out, in which the heavens capsized and the earth was ripped asunder. This land was then plunged into the dark ocean depths.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: However, the heavenly order seemed to not wish for those who remembered all this to remain on the earth. We searched and searched for a road of return, but there was none to be found.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: Much, much later, heaven's powers of prohibition would gradually weaken. Thus did Watatsumi Omikami manage to fall into this place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Dainichi Mikoshi.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: The Dainichi Mikoshi was constructed by the Sage Abrax. It has the power to bring light to the dark depths.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: It has quite a few other functions, to boot.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: All in all, it is a very powerful device.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got nothing else to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Eboshi
dialogues.text: Fair enough. Again, please remember to keep all that you have seen here in Enkanomiya an eternal secret.
